name: Default
shortDescription: Web UI for SANE scanners: preview, scan, crop, apply filters and OCR, then download documents as PDF, JPG, PNG, TIF or text.

alerts.message: Scanners are reached over the network only, so they must be reachable from this server: USB scanners and mDNS auto-discovery are not available. Set SANED_NET_HOSTS, AIRSCAN_DEVICES or PIXMA_HOSTS (semicolon separated) to your scanner addresses and redeploy.
The UI is protected by HTTP basic auth. Sign in with SCANSERVJS_USER and the generated SCANSERVJS_PASSWORD from the environment variables.
